name: kimi_k3_kda_conv_strided_rows_proj1536_width4

n_tokens.description: Tokens of every sequence, back to back.

proj.description: Channels of each of q, k and v on this rank.

dim.description: Channels of the packed q|k|v: 3 * proj.

x.description: The packed q|k|v projection before the convolution: x[t, 0] is q's, x[t, 1] k's, x[t, 2] v's.

weight.description: Each packed channel's taps, the oldest input's first; float32, as vLLM keeps Kimi-K3's.

conv_state.description: The paged convolution state, vLLM's SD layout: per slot, its last width - 1 inputs, oldest first, each a row of every packed channel (vLLM's slot may hold more rows, for speculative decoding: the first width - 1 are these). Written in place.

has_initial_state.description: Whether each sequence resumes from its slot's state, else from zeros.

cu_seqlens.description: Where each sequence's tokens start, then where the last ends.

description: Kimi-K3's KDA short convolution as vLLM runs it on ROCm (kda.py's fused q/k/v causal conv1d, aiter's causal_conv1d_split_qkv_triton_tile_fn), every sequence's tokens back to back: sequence s owns rows cu_seqlens[s]:cu_seqlens[s + 1] of x and slot state_indices[s] of conv_state. Per channel c of the packed q|k|v (c = part * proj + j for x[:, part, j]), the window is conv_state[slot, :, c] (when has_initial_state[s], else width - 1 zeros) then the sequence's inputs; token t's y[t, c] = silu(sum_j weight[c, j] * window[t + j]) in float32, rounded to x's dtype; the window's last width - 1 entries are written back to conv_state[slot, :, c]. q = y[:, :proj], k = y[:, proj:2 * proj], v = y[:, 2 * proj:]. Slots no sequence names are left unchanged. x's rows and conv_state's slots are dense and more than a row or a slot apart.
